item.title: Young man moderately to seriously injured in violent incident in Shibli
item.description:
A young man in his 20s was moderately to seriously injured in a violent incident in Shibli.
Magen David Adom teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

item.description: Police have begun gathering material following a complaint filed by Yair Netanyahu against Haaretz journalist Uri Misgav, alleging that he exposed Netanyahu’s locations in Miami.

item.title: Trump doesn't rule out arming the Iranian people
item.description:
President Donald Trump was asked on Wednesday whether he would send the CIA to arm Iranian citizens after he asked on Truth Social: "When are the Iranian people going to rise up against and fight?"
While the President did not answer directly, he did not rule it out.
"I understand their plight. They are being shot right now... As of three months ago, 52,000 protesters were killed. Now I hear that probably 20-25 thousand more were killed. They have killed close to 65,000 protesters. So when I ask that question, I ask it knowing the answer. The answer is that they are being shot. The regime is getting weaker by the day, and at some point they won't be able to shoot so easily because the people are not going to take it."
Sorry, that tweet doesn't exist!

item.description: Religious Zionism gains two seats after joining forces with Moshe Feiglin, while Ofer Winter’s Amcha Yisrael falls from eight seats to five in i24News poll.

item.description: The operation to capture the “head of Hamas’ Shin Bet" in the heart of Gaza is just the tip of the iceberg of daily Shin Bet and IDF activity inside the Strip. Former senior Shin Bet official explains.

item.title: Trump reassures Israel after US strikes Iran: ‘I will take care of Israel’
item.description: US President Donald Trump reassures Israel following renewed US-Iran hostilities: 'Israel should not worry. You know why? Because I’m the president, and I will take care of Israel.'

item.title: Netanyahu on Iran: We are working to bring down this regime and defeat it
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an interview with Neve Dromi on i24NEWS that Israel has not yet completed its mission in Iran.
“All of our systems, under my direction, are working to bring down this regime and defeat it," he said.

item.title: Iranian media: Death toll of strikes rise to 18
item.description: Iranian media reported that the death toll from the strikes in the country has risen to 18. According to the reports, another 109 people were injured.

item.title: Trump to Channel 12: Israel doesn't need to worry about a renewed war with Iran
item.description:
US President Donald Trump told Channel 12 that Israel need not worry about a renewed war with Iran.
“Israel should not worry. You know why? Because I’m the president, and I will take care of Israel," Trump told Channel 12 in a phone call.

item.title: IDF to punish soldier who prayed at Eleazar’s Tomb
item.description: A reservist who was documented praying at the tomb of Eleazar son of Aaron in Area B will be investigated and disciplined.

item.title: Herzog reveals roll of terrorist who was arrested
item.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed the arrest of Hamas terrorist Muin al-Arbid in an interview with CNN, calling it “a very important step toward achieving the objective."
Herzog said al-Arbid was responsible for efforts to thwart attempts to remove Hamas from power in Gaza and disarm the terrorist organization, as well as “the way the hostages were held in the tunnels."

item.title: Netanyahu spills the secret - and the entire yeshiva breaks into song
item.description: Netanyahu receives a singing and dancing welcome at Sderot Hesder Yeshiva, then surprises students by revealing Rabbi David Fendel’s birthday.

item.title: Trump suggests changing Strait of Hormuz to Trump Strait
item.description:
US President Donald Trump shared post suggesting the name of the Strait of Hormuz be changed to the "Trump Strait."
"Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be “hotter" than ever before," he wrote on Truth Social.

item.title: Watch: IDF continues to destroy Hamas tunnels in Gaza
item.description: Since the implementation of the ceasefire agreement, troops have disabled more than 26 kilometers of underground terror tunnels east of the Yellow Line.

item.title: IDF admits: Shabbat training exercise was a mistake
item.description: Following soldiers’ complaints to Arutz Sheva, the IDF confirms: There was no operational reason to hold the training exercise on Shabbat, and it infringed on the soldiers’ religious way of life.

item.title: Police hunt Qusra riot suspects, seize vehicles in Samaria operation
item.description: Police and Shin Bet intensify their search for suspects in the Qusra clashes, seizing vehicles as two are arrested for disrupting an operation.
